method: Buy-and-hold from inception at the inception close, weights fixed at inception (no rebalance). Price return only (no dividends). Next 13F rebalance dates (about 14 Nov 2026) are outside the test week.
source_note: Weights come from docs/research/famous-investors.md (Q2 2026 13Fs filed around 14 Aug 2026, secondary sources, unverified against SEC). activist_13d.name: 13D activist event basket
activist_13d.basis: Needs EDGAR (SC 13D filings), blocked in this container. NO HOLDINGS: nothing is fabricated
activist_13d.construction: Named activists: Elliott, Starboard, Third Point, Pershing, Trian, ValueAct, Jana, Ancora, Sachem Head, Engaged, Engine No.1, Politan, Icahn, Land & Buildings, Legion. Filter: market cap > $1bn, ADV > $5m. Entry: buy at the next open after the SC 13D filing. Exit: hold 60 trading days or until a 13D/A shows a stake cut. Equal weight, cap 20 names. Benchmarks IWM, SPY, DDDIX. Filing lag is 5 business days since Feb 2024
activist_13d.populate_note: The owner's machine (EDGAR access) must populate positions with dated entries before this can be tracked.

insider_cluster.name: Insider cluster-buy basket
insider_cluster.basis: Needs EDGAR (Form 4), blocked in this container. NO HOLDINGS: nothing is fabricated. Shadow only: small/mid caps are outside the D3 tradable universe
insider_cluster.construction: Feature insider_cluster_30d: 3 or more distinct non-routine code-P (open-market purchase) buyers within 30 days. Market cap $300m to $5bn, ADV > $2m. Entry 2 business days after the filings, hold 3 to 6 months, equal weight. Benchmark IWM
insider_cluster.populate_note: The owner's machine (EDGAR access) must populate positions with dated entries before this can be tracked.
